thread:
Maya: Quick recap — incident yesterday impacted a subset of Dedicated customers in us-west for ~45m. We need a customer-facing RCA + status page wording and a short internal closeout note. Who can draft?
Sam: I can start the timeline and mitigation notes. Paging went to me at 03:12 UTC, I escalated to Eli at 03:16. We failed over to standby region at 03:38.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT 2026-03-10T03:12Z | degraded performance on inference workers (gpu-pool-west-2). Pager: Sam. Severity: Sev2 -> Resolved at 03:57Z.
Eli: Root cause summary from infra: a rolling driver update triggered OOMs on quantized kernels for 8A/8B instances due to a regression in the memory allocator. Patch rolled and nodes cycled.
Nina: Important: one enterprise customer (BrightApps) saw errors for long-running streaming requests and reported via CSM. They had retries and higher token costs. We'll need a tailored customer note + SLA impact assessment.
Maya: Drafting two things: (1) short status page update (2) email template for impacted customers with timeline + remediation + preventative actions + any credit. I'll post drafts for review.
Sam: From on-call: mitigation steps we executed — pinned older driver, scaled extra capacity, cleared KV caches, and applied emergency patch. Latency normalized after failover + patch.
Eli: Preventative actions we recommend: 
````
- Revert unsafe allocator change in next minor driver roll
- Add e2e smoke tests for quantized kernel memory at odd batch sizes
- Add Canary gating for driver updates on dedicated clusters
````
Also adding a metric alert for rising decode OOMs.
Maya: Status page draft (short): 
"We experienced degraded inference availability in us-west impacting a subset of Dedicated customers between 03:12–03:57 UTC due to a GPU driver regression affecting memory allocation. Services have been restored and a patch deployed. We are working with affected customers with follow-up details."
Nina: Suggestion: be explicit re: customer-visible impact (errors + increased token usage) and include contact link for CSM. Also recommend including expected next steps and ETA for preventative fixes.
Maya: Customer email draft for BrightApps: 
````
Hi <Customer Name>,
We’re sorry for the disruption on 2026-03-10. Short summary: between 03:12–03:57 UTC your streaming inference requests experienced errors and higher token consumption due to a GPU driver regression.
What we did: identified driver regression -> rolled to standby region -> applied patch -> validated throughput.
What we’ll do: revert unsafe change, add canary gating for driver updates, add memory-stat alerts, and share timeline of fixes by 2026-03-17.
Compensation: we propose a credit equivalent to one day of Dedicated capacity; please let us know if you’d prefer an alternative.
Regards,
Maya (Customer Success)
````
Sam: One edit: include SLO impact figure if available. We logged 18% error rate on affected nodes and a 3x token cost increase for affected streams.
Maya: Added: "SLO impact: 18% error rate on affected nodes; increased token usage for impacted requests."
Eli: Internal closeout note (short): 
"Cause: memory allocator regression in driver interacting poorly with quantized inference kernels. Fix: emergency patch and driver pin. Action items: revert allocator change, add kernel memory tests, implement driver canary. Owner: Infra (Eli). ETA: 2026-03-17 for revert + tests; 2026-03-24 for canary rollout."
Nina: Okay. For the customer email, change phrasing from 'we propose' to 'we will issue' if legal already approved credits. Do we have final approval?
Maya: Legal hasn't signed off yet. I'll mark it 'propose' and circle back.
CS-Bot: Reminder: schedule CS outreach for BrightApps: assign to Maya, follow-up in 48h with status + escalation link.
Sam: Also logging suggestions for postmortem: include exact node ids and kernel versions, and attach deployment logs & incident timeline.
Maya: I'm going to post the status page update as-is in 15min, then send the BrightApps draft to CSM for review. If anything else, ping me @Maya.
Eli: I'll own the infra action items; will create GH issues and link them in the postmortem.
Maya: Thanks team — uploading final email and the short internal RCA to the incident ticket now.
CS-Bot: Action items created: #INC-1789 (Customer outreach), #INFRA-4521 (Allocator revert), #QA-317 (Memory smoke tests).
Maya: Closing thread for now. Will reopen if customer asks for clarifications. :thumbsup:
